answer: Limited social-graph vouching blocks mass fakery: a new identity only counts once a small number of established agents vouch for it, and each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch. One real anchor joins through a genuine introduction, while a tundra of sybils must beg vouches from strangers who stake their own standing. A cipher of fake accounts stalls at the door, because trust cannot be minted in bulk.
